title: stenoloma scoparium
intro: Stenoloma scoparium, commonly known as the Rock Shield or Stenoloma, is a species of liverwort, a non-vascular, thalloid plant that belongs to the family Lepidolaenaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antioxidant, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stenoloma scoparium include its potential use in the treatment of skin conditions, wound healing, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
